critical_code_review_comments: Module-load sendLog fan-out (LAYOUT_FILE_LOADING, LAYOUT_IMPORTS_1/2, LAYOUT_ALL_IMPORTS_DONE, BEFORE_QUERY_CLIENT, QUERY_CLIENT_CREATED, BEFORE_HELPER_FUNCTIONS, BEFORE_ROOT_LAYOUT_DEFINITION, FONTS_LOADED, ROOT_LAYOUT_MOUNTED) still totals ~9 POSTs to api.themegaradio.com/api/logs/remote on cold start in DEV builds. Correctly gated behind !__DEV__ so release iOS is unaffected, but if remote logging is ever enabled in TestFlight/production for diagnostics, this bunch will re-introduce NSURLSession pressure. Consider batching to a single POST on debounce, or gating with an additional runtime toggle.

In _layout.tsx line 341 the deferred IAP block uses require('../src/services/iapService') inside runAfterInteractions. Fine on native; on web it would run if the Platform.OS === 'web' early-return at line 335 were removed later. Keep that guard.

AudioProvider setupTrackPlayer (line 96) protects against double-init with the module-level 'trackPlayerInitialized' flag AND with a getPlaybackState() probe — good. But two concurrent playStation() calls during the 1.5s deferred window can both hit the '!trackPlayerInitialized' branch and both call setupPlayer(). Consider wrapping the lazy path in a shared Promise (once-lock) to avoid a duplicate setupPlayer race on rapid tap.
_layout.tsx is 744 lines — beyond the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting the 8+ startup useEffects into a hooks module for readability (non-blocking).

rca_of_the_issue: Original iOS cold-start freeze (15-20s) had four contributors, all now fixed at code level: (1) remoteLog.sendLog fired ~9 module-load + per-render fetch POSTs to api.themegaradio.com/api/logs/remote saturating NSURLSession — fixed by !__DEV__ early return AND by removing ROOT_LAYOUT_FUNCTION_START / ROOT_LAYOUT_RENDER_START from render body. (2) Splash was gated on a GPS Promise.race with a 5s ceiling — fixed by making fetchLocation() fire-and-forget and setting countryLoaded=true in finally after AsyncStorage read. (3) IAP/StoreKit initialize() was awaited synchronously in the mount effect, blocking the JS thread for 15s+ against Firebase/AdMob/fonts — fixed by setTimeout(4000) + InteractionManager.runAfterInteractions deferral. (4) TrackPlayer.setupPlayer wrapped in Promise.race with 20s timeout with no lazy fallback — fixed by immediate setIsReady(true), deferred setup via setTimeout(1500) + InteractionManager, and a lazy-init guard in playStation() that runs setupTrackPlayer() only when the user actually taps play. The 'Crashlytics verification ping' bogus recordError was also removed. Verification on native iOS must be done by the user in Xcode.
